create.name: Adele Satori
create.bio:
Adele Satori is a musician, writer and artist who teaches meditation as a 500-hour authorised teacher of Instinctive Meditation, an approach that invites people to follow what feels natural and restful to them instead of fixed postures, mantras or efforts to empty the mind. Her own practice reconnected her with parts of herself she had set aside, and she now brings the same spirit of curiosity to others, treating music, walking in nature, drawing or a remembered moment as possible doorways into meditation.

Through her project Crafting the Spirit she offers one-to-one meditation coaching by video call, beginning with a free consultation and continuing with hour-long sessions or shorter refreshers, as well as guidance for couples, groups and teams. She also leads sound experiences with acoustic and electronic instruments for gatherings, and classes that use creative practice as a way of finding out more about oneself and one's purpose. Her ambient and meditative music, including improvisations and a piece built on The Radiance Sutras, is shared on Insight Timer, where she has been a featured musician, on YouTube and on Bandcamp, and she writes regularly about creativity and attention on her blog.

courses.title: One-Hour Meditation Coaching Session
courses.description: A one-to-one hour by video call to explore a meditation practice suited to you, in the Instinctive Meditation approach. Booked after a free 30-minute introductory call.

courses.title: 30-Minute Meditation Refresh
courses.description: A shorter session by video call to rest and re-tune your practice, for people who have already had a full session with Adele.

free_resources.title: Adele Satori on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her Insight Timer profile, with her ambient music and guided meditations. The tracks are free to play.

free_resources.title: Free 30-Minute Initial Consultation
free_resources.description: A free half-hour video call to talk about what you are looking for in meditation and whether working together suits you.
